study: stage B independently generated seeds and isolated floor/hold ablation
selection_rule: numpy SeedSequence(2026103001), 24 distinct 31-bit integers, excluding available packaged seed records; selected before performance runs
scope_of_exclusion: all readable packaged audit/results CSVs with a seed column and original formal protocol; full historical inventory may require separate verification

factor_definitions.floor_off: no_reference_floor=True in existing ExtensionOptimized.slot_plan; this isolates the reference communication floor, not the entire joint listening-credit optimizer
factor_definitions.hold_off: keep_lock=False in existing ReviewSimulator.attempt; grant admission, sender/receiver control charges, physical energy, reserve and slots stay enabled; accepted obligations are released immediately
factor_definitions.interaction: 2x2 floor/hold interaction using the same cadence, G/R, physical kernel and seed for all variants

confirmatory_primary.endpoint: source_coverage_p5_pct averaged equally across the 8 condition/supply cells for each seed
confirmatory_primary.test: two-sided paired t test; Holm correction across the two contrasts; 95% unadjusted paired t confidence intervals
confirmatory_primary.direction: positive is larger fifth-percentile coverage; no superiority is assumed

secondary: 2x2 interaction for source P5, per-seed equal-cell average
paired comparisons JLC-R against EADCM-CE and LANTERN-CE for coverage and P5
cell-level heterogeneity, mean coverage, Jain fairness, AoI, energy and safety as descriptive or explicitly secondary

new_weather_prespecified.analysis: separate exploratory paired comparison; not part of primary family
new_weather_prespecified.weather_QC: QC0 GHI, otherwise QC0 DNI*cos(zenith)+QC0 DHI; clip negatives; interpolate interior missing runs <=5 minutes; otherwise fail
new_weather_prespecified.does_not_imply: independent weather replication or new field measurements

pilot.intent: exercise exact switches and resource invariants, not select methods or seeds

failure_rule: write failure diagnostics; no silent discard, replacement, or seed selection
